tools.name: list_social_accounts
tools.description: List the social accounts connected to your Post for Me workspace. Optionally filter by platform (instagram, tiktok, x, ...). Returns account ids you pass to create_post via social_accounts.

id.description: Filter to specific social account ids.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (pagination offset).

tools.name: get_social_account
tools.description: Get a single connected social account by id, including platform, username and status.

tools.name: create_social_account
tools.description: Manually create/connect a social account by supplying its platform and credentials/tokens. For the standard interactive OAuth flow, prefer create_auth_url instead.

access_token.description: OAuth access token for the account.

external_id.description: The platform's native account id, if you have it.

metadata.description: Any additional credential/config fields the platform requires.

tools.name: update_social_account
tools.description: Update a connected social account (e.g. refresh stored credentials or metadata).

metadata.description: Fields to merge into the account metadata.

tools.name: create_auth_url
tools.description: Start the OAuth connect flow for a platform. Returns a URL — open it in a browser to authorize the account; once approved, it appears in list_social_accounts. Use this to connect a new Instagram/TikTok/X/etc.

external_id.description: Your own reference id to correlate the resulting account on your side.

redirect_url.description: Where to send the user after authorizing (overrides the workspace default).

tools.name: disconnect_social_account
tools.description: Disconnect a social account — revokes Post for Me's access. The account stops being usable for posting until reconnected via create_auth_url.

tools.name: list_account_feeds
tools.description: ANALYTICS: list the recent feed for a connected account — the posts on that platform, optionally with engagement metrics (likes, comments, views, etc.). Use this to pull performance data for a given account.

social_account_id.description: The connected social account id to read the feed of.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (pagination offset).

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Create a social post across one or more connected accounts/platforms. This is the primary publishing tool. Set scheduled_at (ISO-8601) to schedule, status='draft' to save without publishing, or omit both to publish immediately. Use platform_configurations for per-network tweaks. For common cases the shortcuts publish_now / schedule_post / create_draft are simpler.

caption.description: The post text/caption. Can be overridden per-platform via platform_configurations.

social_accounts.description: Social account ids to publish to (from list_social_accounts). Required.

url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the image/video to attach.

thumbnail_url.description: Optional thumbnail/cover image URL (used by video platforms).

thumbnail_timestamp_ms.description: Optional timestamp (ms) to auto-generate a video thumbnail from.

tags.description: Optional per-media tags (e.g. user/product tags) where the platform supports them.

media.description: Media to attach (images/videos). Each item references a public URL — see upload_media.

external_id.description: Your own reference id for this post, echoed back in results/webhooks.

tiktok.description: TikTok options (e.g. privacy_level, disable_comment, disable_duet, disable_stitch, title).

platform_configurations.description: Per-platform overrides (Instagram Reels, X polls, TikTok privacy, YouTube title, etc.).

social_account_id.description: The connected account id this override applies to.

configuration.description: Overrides for this specific account (caption, media, platform options).

account_configurations.description: Per-ACCOUNT overrides (finer-grained than platform_configurations) — tweak caption/media/options for a single connected account id.

scheduled_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp to schedule the post (e.g. '2026-07-01T14:30:00Z'). Omit to publish now.

status.description: Explicit status. Usually leave unset; use 'draft' to save without publishing.

tools.name: publish_now
tools.description: Shortcut: publish a post immediately to the given accounts. Equivalent to create_post with no scheduled_at and status='published'.

caption.description: The post text/caption. Can be overridden per-platform via platform_configurations.

social_accounts.description: Social account ids to publish to (from list_social_accounts). Required.

url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the image/video to attach.

thumbnail_url.description: Optional thumbnail/cover image URL (used by video platforms).

thumbnail_timestamp_ms.description: Optional timestamp (ms) to auto-generate a video thumbnail from.

tags.description: Optional per-media tags (e.g. user/product tags) where the platform supports them.

media.description: Media to attach (images/videos). Each item references a public URL — see upload_media.

external_id.description: Your own reference id for this post, echoed back in results/webhooks.

tiktok.description: TikTok options (e.g. privacy_level, disable_comment, disable_duet, disable_stitch, title).

platform_configurations.description: Per-platform overrides (Instagram Reels, X polls, TikTok privacy, YouTube title, etc.).

social_account_id.description: The connected account id this override applies to.

configuration.description: Overrides for this specific account (caption, media, platform options).

account_configurations.description: Per-ACCOUNT overrides (finer-grained than platform_configurations) — tweak caption/media/options for a single connected account id.

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description: Shortcut: schedule a post for a future time. Equivalent to create_post with scheduled_at set and status='scheduled'.

caption.description: The post text/caption. Can be overridden per-platform via platform_configurations.

social_accounts.description: Social account ids to publish to (from list_social_accounts). Required.

url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the image/video to attach.

thumbnail_url.description: Optional thumbnail/cover image URL (used by video platforms).

thumbnail_timestamp_ms.description: Optional timestamp (ms) to auto-generate a video thumbnail from.

tags.description: Optional per-media tags (e.g. user/product tags) where the platform supports them.

media.description: Media to attach (images/videos). Each item references a public URL — see upload_media.

external_id.description: Your own reference id for this post, echoed back in results/webhooks.

tiktok.description: TikTok options (e.g. privacy_level, disable_comment, disable_duet, disable_stitch, title).

platform_configurations.description: Per-platform overrides (Instagram Reels, X polls, TikTok privacy, YouTube title, etc.).

social_account_id.description: The connected account id this override applies to.

configuration.description: Overrides for this specific account (caption, media, platform options).

account_configurations.description: Per-ACCOUNT overrides (finer-grained than platform_configurations) — tweak caption/media/options for a single connected account id.

scheduled_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp for when to publish (e.g. '2026-07-01T14:30:00Z'). Required.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Shortcut: save a post as a draft without publishing or scheduling it. Equivalent to create_post with status='draft'.

caption.description: The post text/caption. Can be overridden per-platform via platform_configurations.

social_accounts.description: Social account ids to publish to (from list_social_accounts). Required.

url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the image/video to attach.

thumbnail_url.description: Optional thumbnail/cover image URL (used by video platforms).

thumbnail_timestamp_ms.description: Optional timestamp (ms) to auto-generate a video thumbnail from.

tags.description: Optional per-media tags (e.g. user/product tags) where the platform supports them.

media.description: Media to attach (images/videos). Each item references a public URL — see upload_media.

external_id.description: Your own reference id for this post, echoed back in results/webhooks.

tiktok.description: TikTok options (e.g. privacy_level, disable_comment, disable_duet, disable_stitch, title).

platform_configurations.description: Per-platform overrides (Instagram Reels, X polls, TikTok privacy, YouTube title, etc.).

social_account_id.description: The connected account id this override applies to.

configuration.description: Overrides for this specific account (caption, media, platform options).

account_configurations.description: Per-ACCOUNT overrides (finer-grained than platform_configurations) — tweak caption/media/options for a single connected account id.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get a single social post by id, including its status, caption, media and target accounts.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List social posts, optionally filtered by status (draft/scheduled/published/error) and paginated. Use this to review queued, scheduled or published content.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (pagination offset).

tools.name: update_post
tools.description: Update an existing post by id — change the caption, media, target accounts, schedule or platform_configurations. Works on drafts and scheduled posts.

social_accounts.description: Replace the set of target social account ids.

url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the image/video to attach.

thumbnail_url.description: Optional thumbnail/cover image URL (used by video platforms).

thumbnail_timestamp_ms.description: Optional timestamp (ms) to auto-generate a video thumbnail from.

tags.description: Optional per-media tags (e.g. user/product tags) where the platform supports them.

tiktok.description: TikTok options (e.g. privacy_level, disable_comment, disable_duet, disable_stitch, title).

social_account_id.description: The connected account id this override applies to.

configuration.description: Overrides for this specific account (caption, media, platform options).

tools.name: reschedule_post
tools.description: Shortcut: move a scheduled post to a new time. Equivalent to update_post with only scheduled_at set.

scheduled_at.description: New ISO-8601 timestamp to publish at (e.g. '2026-07-02T09:00:00Z').

tools.name: delete_post
tools.description: Delete a social post by id (drafts, scheduled or published records).

tools.name: list_post_results
tools.description: ANALYTICS: list publishing results across posts — each row is the outcome of one post on one platform (success/error, native post id & URL). Filter by social_post_id to see how a specific post fared on every target account.

social_post_id.description: Filter results to a single social post id.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (pagination offset).

tools.name: get_post_result
tools.description: Get a single post result by id — the detailed outcome of one post on one platform, including the native post URL/id and any error message.

tools.name: create_post_preview
tools.description: Generate a preview of how a post would appear on each target platform, without publishing it. Pass the same caption/media/social_accounts/platform_configurations you'd send to create_post. Great for a confirm-before-publish step.

social_accounts.description: Social account ids to preview the post for.

url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the image/video to attach.

thumbnail_url.description: Optional thumbnail/cover image URL (used by video platforms).

thumbnail_timestamp_ms.description: Optional timestamp (ms) to auto-generate a video thumbnail from.

tags.description: Optional per-media tags (e.g. user/product tags) where the platform supports them.

media.description: Media to include in the preview.

tiktok.description: TikTok options (e.g. privacy_level, disable_comment, disable_duet, disable_stitch, title).

platform_configurations.description: Per-platform overrides to reflect in the preview.

social_account_id.description: The connected account id this override applies to.

configuration.description: Overrides for this specific account (caption, media, platform options).

account_configurations.description: Per-account overrides to reflect in the preview ({ social_account_id, configuration }).

tools.name: create_media_upload_url
tools.description: Get a signed URL to upload a media file. Returns an upload_url (PUT your bytes there) and the media URL to reference in a post. Prefer upload_media if you want the upload done for you in one step.

content_type.description: MIME type of the file you'll upload (e.g. 'image/jpeg', 'video/mp4').

tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: One-step media upload: provide a local file path OR a public URL, and this generates a signed URL, uploads the bytes, and returns { media_url } ready to drop into create_post/publish_now/schedule_post media. Use this whenever you need to attach an image or video.

file_path.description: Absolute path to a local image/video file to upload.

source_url.description: Public URL of media to fetch and re-upload (alternative to file_path).

content_type.description: Override the MIME type (auto-detected from extension otherwise).

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks configured in your workspace.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (pagination offset).

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: Get a single webhook by id.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook that POSTs to your HTTPS endpoint when the chosen events occur (e.g. post published, post errored). Subscribe to specific event types or all of them.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint that will receive event payloads.

event_types.description: Event types to subscribe to (e.g. 'social.post.created', 'social.post.updated', 'social.post.result.created'). Omit to receive all events.

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Update a webhook's URL or subscribed event types.

event_types.description: New set of event types to subscribe to.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook by id.

tools.name: postforme_raw
tools.description: Call any Post for Me REST endpoint directly (escape hatch for full API coverage). Provide the HTTP method and the FULL path INCLUDING the version segment (e.g. '/v1/social-posts' or '/v1/social-accounts/acc_xxx'), plus optional query params and JSON body. Use this only when no dedicated tool exists. Auth, retries and rate-limiting are handled for you. Reference: https://api.postforme.dev/docs

path.description: Full path including version, starting with '/'. Example: '/v1/social-posts'.
